en.headline: Kwun Tong food factory sample of meat and vegetable bun fails Bacillus cereus test
en.dek: The Centre for Food Safety found 250,000 organisms per gram in the ready-to-eat bun, well above the 100,000 unsatisfactory threshold, and ordered sales stopped.
body: The Centre for Food Safety of the Food and Environmental Hygiene Department announced that a sample of a bun with fresh meat and preserved vegetable collected from a food factory in Kwun Tong contained 250,000 Bacillus cereus per gram.

Under the Microbiological Guidelines for Food, ready-to-eat food containing more than 100,000 Bacillus cereus per gram is considered unsatisfactory. The CFS has ordered the factory to stop selling and discard the affected product, and to clean and disinfect thoroughly.

Staff were given food safety and hygiene education. Bacillus cereus is common in the environment; unhygienic processing or storage can allow it to grow. Eating contaminated food can cause vomiting and diarrhoea.
All food sold in Hong Kong must be fit for human consumption. An offender is liable on conviction to a maximum fine of HK$50,000 and six months’ imprisonment. The investigation continues.

zh.headline: 觀塘食物廠鮮肉榨菜包樣本檢出過量蠟樣芽孢桶菌
zh.dek: 食安中心指樣本每克吥25萬個菌，超出即食食品每克10萬個的不滿意標準，已飾令停售棄置及徹底清潔消毒。
body: 食物環境衛生署食物安全中心今日公布，從觀塘一間食物製造廠抽取的鮮肉榨菜包樣本，檢出每克吥25萬個蠟樣芽孢桶菌。
根據《食品微生物含量指引》，即食食品每克含超過10萬個蠟樣芽孢桶菌即屬不滿意。中心已即時調查，並知會廠方，廠方已按指示停售和棄置相關食品，並進行徹底清潔和消毒。
中心亦向員工提供食物安全和衛生教育。蠟樣芽孢桶菌普遍存在於環境中，製作或貯存過程欠缺衛生可引致繁殖，進食可能引致嘔吐及腹瀉。
根據《公眾衛生及市政條例》，在港出售的食物必須適合供人食用，違者最高可被判罰款5萬元及監禁6個月。調查仍在繼續。
